name: ai-handbook
description: Tooling dependencies for the handbook's own checks. The PAYLOAD (core/) stays dependency-free; this file is the handbook's, and ships nowhere. NO "type" FIELD, deliberately: every check here is .mjs and so is ESM regardless, while two payload files under core/.claude/skills/ are CommonJS .js -- "type": "module" reinterprets THOSE and render-graphs.js dies on its first require(). A root manifest added for one check reaches every unscoped file beneath it.
